subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Loyalty Cards Know Too Much
description: A fast breakdown of Loyalty Cards Know Too Much for builders.

hook.text: Your grocery loyalty card doesn't just give you discounts. It builds a detailed profile of your life.

buildup.text: Every purchase is recorded: what you eat, what medicine you buy, what time you shop.

discovery.text: Target famously predicted a teenager was pregnant before her father knew — based on purchase patterns.

twist.text: The 'discount' is the price for surrendering your shopping behavior to corporate analytics.

climax.text: Loyalty programs are surveillance programs with a friendlier name and a coupon attached.

quiz.question: How did Target predict a customer's pregnancy?
options: By analyzing patterns in her purchase history
By reading her social media posts
